features.description: Phase-2 commit-on-submit on step-2 voltage slider. Slider writes to local pendingChanges map; nothing reaches the host until Record-threshold button OR inbound ui/notifications/chat-flush notification. On flush, emit one state-change event with triggeredBy: 'record' or 'chat-submit' and the final voltage. Commitment events from M3 (step-change, measurement, component-placed, polarity-error) keep firing immediately.
acceptance_criteria: Dragging the voltage slider produces zero host messages

Inbound ui/notifications/chat-flush flushes as triggeredBy: chat-submit
No-op when pendingChanges is empty (clicking Record without fresh slider value)
